title: August 2026 — 29-Gallon Aquarium R&D Journal
body: August documented a major deep-maintenance discovery inside the drain plumbing, slower nitrate accumulation after the August 9 reset, continued reduced feeding, a switch to Thrive S, expanded chemistry tracking, BBA stabilization, and preparation for future top-off optimization.
